assumptions.statement: Official polygons, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, existing buildings, utilities, heritage, flood and fire conditions are missing.
assumptions.impact: All parcel, intensity, alignment, retain-renovate-demolish and engineering statements remain conceptual and must be recomputed or withdrawn when cleared data arrives.

assumptions.statement: The maintainer-supplied provisional boundary is used only for generation, visualization and intake self-check.
assumptions.impact: Area and ratio values describe this submitted temporary geometry, not an official redline or statutory indicator.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, opening hours, food-service licensing and event calendars are unconfirmed.
assumptions.impact: The Common Table operating model is a reference scheme for later professional and community co-design, not a government commitment.

assumptions.statement: All AI services require purpose limitation, minimum data, visible operator, human fallback, complaint handling and stop criteria before any pilot.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards are test protocols, not claims that systems are deployed or compliant.
